Laura: Start calling them what they are — 'insurgents'

Video

🚨 BIDEN COVER-UP: WHAT ELSE DID THEY LIE ABOUT? 🚨

@KellyannePolls: “If they would lie about something that we see with our own eyes and hear with our own ears, what else are they covering up?”

“What else do we not know?”

Video

🚨 PAT FALLON: NO URANIUM. NO DEAL. 🚨

Rep. Pat Fallon: “It cannot stay under Iranian control, period, end of story.”

“Anything short of that, and we can't accept it.”

Video

🚨 NEW JERSEY CREATED THIS MESS — NOW THEY’RE BLAMING ICE 🚨

Paul Kanitra: “@GovSherrillNJ had been in office just for a couple weeks before they wound up passing, and she signed three radical illegal immigration bills.”

“Which are part of the reason for this whole crazy crisis in the first place.”

Video

🚨 DEMOCRATS ONLY CARE WHEN THE STORY FITS THE NARRATIVE 🚨

Paul Kanitra: “They selectively pick the outrage.”

“They're protesting the chaos that they themselves have created.”

Video

🚨 FROM CHEST BUMPS TO COMMENCEMENT SPEECHES 🚨

@VP Vance looks like he's having the time of his life.

As @jimmyfailla pointed out, it's a nice change from the last Air Force Academy speech everyone remembers, where Joe Biden tripped over a sandbag and then shook hands with invisible people

Video

🚨 TALARICO IS RUNNING FROM HIS OWN RECORD 🚨

Byron York: “Talarico is trying to undo and backtrack from some of the worst things he said during the woke era.”

“As far as the ‘there are six sexes’ thing, he ran away from that at 100 miles an hour.”

Video

Remember, Biden said he ran because of Charlottesville (which was funded and organized with the help of the SPLC).  But this NJ mob attack on law & order they celebrate.

Video

🚨 KATIE MILLER: THIS IS THE DEMOCRAT PARTY’S RHETORIC NOW 🚨

@KatieMiller: “This is the same violent political rhetoric that is leading people to shooting up... President Trump in Butler.”

“What a sad state for the pathetic Democrat Party.”

Video

🚨 ZOHRAN MAMDANI AND KATHY HOCHUL DO NOT BELIEVE IN PROPERTY RIGHTS 🚨

Bruce Blakeman: “If you own a single-family home, a two-family home, an apartment house, a co-op, a condo, a small business, a grocery store, a bodega, Zohran Mamdani wants to take your property.”

“And comrade Kathy Hochul will not stop him.”

Video

TEXAS REPUBLICANS JUST SENT WASHINGTON A MESSAGE.

Republican voters want action, not words.

They want the Trump agenda codified into law.

Video

🚨 NEIGHBORS IN SEATTLE ARE PUTTING UP THEIR OWN BARRIERS BECAUSE THE CITY WON’T FIX THE CHAOS 🚨

@jasonrantz: “You've got a bunch of neighbors who are sick and tired of almost 100 separate shootings.”

“Open air drug use, prostitution everywhere, homelessness everywhere.”

Video

🚨 THE ABRAHAM ACCORDS WERE NEVER JUST A PHOTO OP 🚨

Victoria Coates: “This was the president's vision from his June 2017 trip to Saudi Arabia.”

“He has pursued this methodically since then.”

Video
Laura: Democrats Won’t Admit Trump Made America Safer
Rep. Chip Roy: “Iran’s radical theocracy has held the world HOSTAGE.”
Mike Sarraille: “Iran is using the Strait of Hormuz as a pressure LEVER.”
Gordon Chang: “Iran’s nuclear program exists because of CHINA.”
Sen. Eric Schmitt: “Democrats care more about DEFUNDING ICE than securing the border.”
Kevin Donegan: “Iran’s pressure tactics are acts of TERRORISM.”
Gordon Chang: “President Trump should not go to BEIJING.”
Dan Bongino: “Lone actors worry me more than sleeper cells.”
Stefano Ritondale: “A CONVICTED ISIS sympathizer was still free.”
Morgan Wright: “The laws SHOULD change for convicted terrorists.”
